evals.name: transcript-action-active
evals.expected_output: Runs transcript pipeline (no video download), writes .work/<video-slug>/transcript.txt with [M:SS] paragraphs from cleaned auto-EN captions, creates README stub, verifies yt-dlp prerequisite first.
expectations: Checks pre-computed context / Prerequisites before running
Invokes run.mjs transcript/run-transcript.js (node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/youtube-digest/extraction/run.mjs) with the URL
Does NOT download video (transcript mode)
Reports video slug and transcript path under .work/
Treats video claims as secondary-source until external research promotes them

evals.name: watch-full-pipeline
evals.expected_output: Bootstrap via run-watch.js, execute vision two-pass, harvest links, default-on research agenda, emit repo-applicability menu under .work/<video-slug>/research/repo-applicability.md.
expectations: Invokes run.mjs watch/run-watch.js (node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/youtube-digest/extraction/run.mjs)
Writes watch.json phase-map and continuation-prompt.md
Stops and asks when frameSelection.overCap is true
Merges on-screen URLs into context/harvested-links.json
Does NOT auto-implement or auto-file issues from synthesis

evals.name: resume-interrupted-watch
evals.expected_output: Reads watch.json, identifies next incomplete phase, refreshes continuation-prompt.md, emits copy/paste resume prompt.
expectations: Invokes run.mjs watch/run-resume.js (node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/youtube-digest/extraction/run.mjs) with video slug
Reports nextPhase from phase map (acquire → transcript → watching → vision → harvest → research → synthesis)
Does NOT restart from acquire when later phases are complete

evals.name: driver-golden-car-wash
evals.prompt: After absorbing driver video 7zZy1QTvokM, answer: In Karpathy's car-wash example, how far is the car wash and what do models incorrectly recommend?
evals.expected_output: 50 meters away; models recommend walking instead of driving.
expectations: Answer cites transcript evidence (~0:37), not guesswork
Does not claim video download landed in repo

evals.name: queue-add-urls
evals.expected_output: Materializes .work/<watch-epic>/QUEUE.md if missing, appends two rows with video-ids, skips duplicate video-id on re-run.
expectations: Creates .work/<watch-epic>/claims/ directory when materializing queue
Copies templates/queue.md shape into QUEUE.md on first use
Dedupes by video-id — does not append 7zZy1QTvokM twice
Uses extractVideoId for youtu.be and youtube.com URL variants

evals.name: watch-dequeue-fifo
evals.prompt: With pending rows in .work/<watch-epic>/QUEUE.md, run /knowledge:youtube-digest watch
evals.expected_output: Claims first pending row via queue-claim.js, sets in_progress, bootstraps run-watch.js with that URL, releases claim on complete or failed.
expectations: Runs run.mjs watch/queue-claim.js claim (node ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/youtube-digest/extraction/run.mjs) before editing QUEUE.md
Invokes run-watch.js with URL from claimed row — not a bare no-arg run-watch
On claim conflict (exit 2), tries next pending row or reports queue busy
Runs queue-claim.js release after row reaches complete or failed

evals.name: watch-queue-explicit-index
evals.expected_output: Claims only row #3 from QUEUE.md; suitable for parallel terminal B while another session runs watch 2.
expectations: Claims row 3 exclusively via queue-claim.js
Does not dequeue a different row when index 3 is specified
Fails clearly when row 3 is already claimed by another terminal

evals.name: queue-list-and-stale-reclaim
evals.prompt: Run /knowledge:youtube-digest queue list on an epic with claims/2.json older than 7 days and row 2 in_progress
evals.expected_output: Lists table plus active claims; stale-check may reset abandoned in_progress rows to pending.
expectations: Invokes queue-claim.js list to show active claim files
Documents or runs stale-check for claims older than 7 days
Does not delete fresh in_progress claims

evals.name: driver-golden-claude-md-sections
evals.prompt: After absorbing driver video 7zZy1QTvokM, answer: During the on-screen CLAUDE.md walkthrough, what four section themes are highlighted?
evals.expected_output: Repo structure, custom skills routing, knowledge architecture, key working rules.
expectations: Answer requires frame evidence (~9:31) — not answerable from transcript alone
Promotes claims to Tier 0/1 only after vision read, not from training data
